newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton subdued, buyers in no hurry.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton subdued, buyers in no hurry.

text.p: Trading in raw cotton was subdued in the absence of fresh price stimulus with New York futures needing new direction and traders' asking rates generally steady.

Some fresh contracts have been arranged involving Central Asian cottons in certain European markets including Belgium, but a wide divergence exists on price ideas between buyers and sellers price ideas.

Buyers seem in no hurry to cover outstanding shipment requirements for the summer months. Despite expectations in some quarters that supplies may be tight for particular qualities, mill demand shows no sign of increasing.
